## Summary
<!-- 1–3 sentences: WHAT this PR changes and WHY. Be concrete and specific.
     Greptile compares the diff against this intent and flags deviations
     (accidental scope creep, unrelated edits). Vague summaries → worse reviews. -->

**Type:** <!-- Feature | Bugfix | Refactor | Build/CI | Docs -->

## Changes
<!-- Human-readable map of the diff so reviewers don't reverse-engineer it.
     Group by area when helpful. Fine to keep short for tiny PRs. -->
-

## Review focus
<!-- Where should reviewers AND Greptile look hardest? Tricky logic, a decision
     you're unsure about, a trade-off made. If none, write "Standard review". -->

## Testing
<!-- How this was verified: tests added/updated, manual steps, commands run.
     If not tested, say so and why. -->

## Linear
<!-- Also auto-links via the branch name (lara-123-...). Use "Closes LARA-123" to move the
     issue to Done on merge, or "Ref LARA-123" to link WITHOUT closing (e.g. one of several
     PRs on the same issue). Any team prefix works (LARA-, etc.). -->
Closes LARA-
